title: David A Probable NDE 216
content: I remember going to bed, the night before the accident, and waking in the hospital after experiencing a most remarkable dream. I dreamt that I was flying alongside of a helicopter facing downward, and could see that we were coming down for a landing at a hospital landing site. Then, a sense of void and darkness surrounded me, and I could sense a presence watching me and causing me to experience what would follow. I tried to move my arms and touch my face, but I had no arms or hands to do so. I tried repeatedly, attempting to use any part of my body, but I seemed to no longer have a body. I became enraged and soon afterward, I could feel other beings in my same state, and they were angry too. I could feel them searching for a place to go, and that they were envious of anyone with a body. I thought to myself that this is hell, and I said to whoever it was that was watching me that I didn't want to be like that. Suddenly, I could feel that I was curled up in a fetal position and I could see a tunnel with a light at the end. I somehow knew I was in a woman's vagina, about to be born. I also somehow was told by the one watching me that I will forget everything and learn it all over again, and that there was no guaranty that I will be ok. I thought to myself, this is what it must be like for angels who don't have any experience. They're like children and could easily be fooled, or hurt. I refused, and suddenly another being took my place in the womb. Then I saw children laughing and playing, and teenagers talking with each other, and young people going through experiences and learning from them. I saw them becoming old and calming down from their worries and finding peace, which made them happy. I said, 'This is what I want; a life in a human body with the ability to taste, touch and feel, smell, and see, and especially the knowledge between good and bad. I want to live and to have an advantage over the other two states of being.' Then I awoke in the hospital. I was trying to figure out if I was dreaming or awake. I became afraid because of what I had just experienced and I thought that I maybe was being tested in another way. It all seemed like a dream from January 14, 2000 to February 19, 2000 when I started retaining my memory. I realized that I was actually awake and that being in the hospital related a lot more to what I feel I learned from this experience and how I view life now, but I'm trying to be as brief as I can.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Dreamt of flying alongside a helicopter facing downward and coming down for a landing at a hospital landing site.

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'presence watching me and causing me to experience what would follow'; later 'other beings in my same state' who were angry and envious of anyone with a body.

environment.environment_other_detail: Void and darkness; later a tunnel with a light at the end; later visions of children/teenagers/young people aging.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: He desired a human life with a body and the ability to sense and learn 'the knowledge between good and bad,' and refused being placed in a womb until choosing this.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived being in a womb ('in a woman's vagina, about to be born'), being told he would forget and learn again, refusing and another being taking his place, and observing humans across life stages (children to old age).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Helicopter/flight imagery → void/darkness with watching presence and bodiless state → awareness of other angry bodiless beings → tunnel with light and womb/birth scenario → scenes of human life stages → awakening in hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Explicit womb/birth scenario: 'I somehow knew I was in a woman's vagina, about to be born' and 'another being took my place in the womb.' Also conceptualization of bodiless beings as envious/angry and comparison to angels as childlike/inexperienced.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Then, a sense of void and darkness surrounded me, and I could sense a presence watching me...” “I tried to move my arms and touch my face, but I had no arms or hands...” “I thought to myself that this is hell...” “I somehow knew I was in a woman's vagina, about to be born.” “I will forget everything and learn it all over again, and that there was no guaranty that I will be ok.” “I refused, and suddenly another being took my place in the womb.”
